verdict.rationale: Persona's Reports API explicitly supports Watchlist, PEP, and Adverse Media screening (persona-docs-15), can be orchestrated silently alongside identity verification within the same integration (persona-docs-25), and can be scheduled to run periodically for continuous monitoring (persona-docs-19, persona-docs-28), with Workflows enabling automated tagging and decisioning across these checks (persona-docs-23) — all under one API/vendor and webhook-driven review surface (persona-docs-21). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that the unified review UI actually surfaces all three screening types together in practice, rather than only documented API capability.
